description: Presidential Secretariat - members of the Presidential Task Force for Gama Samaga Pilisandara (Dialogue with the Village)
categorisation: This gazette contains both specific named individuals (16 ministers and state ministers, including Hon. Namal Rajapaksa as Chairman) AND detailed descriptions of their responsibilities and duties related to the "Gama Samaga Pilisandara" rural development program. The content includes both the "who" (government personnel) and "what" (detailed portfolio responsibilities and specific tasks they are directed to perform), making it a Hybrid Gazette according to the classification rules.
